title: Monomial of a scaled pointwise product
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $b$ be a sign, let $x$ and $y$ be vectors of $n$ signs, and let $S$ be a subset of the coordinate indices. The monomial indexed by $S$ at the vector with coordinates $b x_i y_i$ equals the sign value of $b$ raised to $|S|$, times the monomial indexed by $S$ at $x$, times the monomial indexed by $S$ at $y$.
